injuries.injury: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Monday's game against Cleveland.
injuries.detail: Miller suffered a groin injury in Friday's 119-80 loss to the Celtics and didn't return. More information on his condition is expected to be released by Monday. For now, Tidjane Salaun and Sion James are candidates to replace Miller in the starting lineup versus the Cavaliers.

injuries.injury: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
injuries.detail: Schroder, who missed Friday's game due to what was described as a left thigh injury, has been diagnosed with a hamstring strain. He is set to be reevaluated in two weeks, suggesting he will miss at least the next five games. Christian Anderson and Sion James could see extra minutes with Schroder sidelined.

injuries.injury: Williams (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.
injuries.detail: Williams has yet to appear in a game this season due to a right hamstring strain. His next opportunity to suit up comes Thursday against the Suns.

injuries.injury: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
injuries.detail: Knueppel missed the first eight games of the 2026-27 campaign. He returned for the 114-104 loss to Brooklyn on Wednesday, though he exited the contest after just six minutes of work and didn't return. With Knueppel out of commission for at least a month, Grayson Allen and Sion James are candidates to replace him in the starting lineup, especially with Dennis Schroder (hamstring) sidelined for a minimum of two weeks.

injuries.injury: Diabate (quadriceps) has been downgraded to out for Monday's game against Cleveland.
injuries.detail: The Hornets initially appeared optimistic about the big man's status for Monday, as he was added to the injury report as questionable Sunday. However, he was downgraded to doubtful earlier in the day Monday and has since been ruled out. The Michigan product will miss his second straight matchup due to right quadriceps tendinopathy.

injuries.injury: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.
injuries.detail: Although there haven't been any negative reports regarding Lively's rehab progress, it doesn't appear he will be back in the lineup anytime soon. For now, the 22-year-old should be considered week-to-week. While Lively remains on the shelf, Daniel Gafford and Moussa Cisse should continue to handle most of the work at the five. Santi Aldama (knee) might also get involved in that area once he's cleared to return.

injuries.injury: Johnson (leg) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers.
injuries.detail: Johnson will miss his first game of the 2026-27 campaign after tallying four points, nine rebounds and one assist in 19 minutes in the first half of a back-to-back set Sunday against Brooklyn. His absence could open up more minutes for Santi Aldama and Moussa Cisse behind starting center Daniel Gafford.

injuries.injury: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.
injuries.detail: De Larrea continues to miss time with a right knee strain, and it's not clear at this time where he's at in his rehab. He can be considered week-to-week until further notice.

injuries.injury: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.
injuries.detail: Biberovic has been battling inflammation in his right heel, preventing him from making his NBA debut. While the rookie should be considered week-to-week, he likely has a way to go before earning a meaningful role in Dallas even when he's cleared to suit up.

injuries.injury: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.
injuries.detail: Joe is missing a seventh consecutive contest with a bruised hip. His next chance to play comes Thursday in a road rematch with Washington.

injuries.injury: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
injuries.detail: Duren is progressing in his rehab after suffering a right hamstring strain Oct. 23, though he'll remain on the inactive list for at least the next two weeks while ramping up toward a return to game action. Paul Reed should continue to play a sizable role in Duren's stead.

injuries.injury: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.
injuries.detail: The No. 53 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Onyenso appears poised to see run in the G League after putting pen to paper on a two-way deal. He'll likely face an uphill battle to carve out a role in the rotation, so Detroit will presumably allow him to continue his development with Motor City.

injuries.injury: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent debridement surgery in Minnesota, though the team did not provide a timetable for his return. The star guard is expected to make a full recovery, with additional updates coming as he progresses through rehabilitation. Based on previous reporting from ESPN's Shams Charania, Edwards could miss up to two months. Edwards was off to a scorching start this season, averaging 33.3 points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 2.0 steals across four appearances.

injuries.injury: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.

injuries.injury: Bona (back) is out for Tuesday's game against the Celtics.
injuries.detail: Bona will miss his third consecutive matchup while nursing a cervical spine sprain. Jabari Walker should once again receive extra looks behind Joel Embiid with Bona and Dominick Barlow (back) sidelined.

injuries.injury: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
injuries.detail: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.

injuries.injury: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.
injuries.detail: Nurse added that the team is "pretty positive" that Barlow's back is getting better, though he's still going to have to wait some more time before being cleared. The big man has yet to make his season debut due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, and he isn't expected to return until mid-November at the earliest.

injuries.injury: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injuries.detail: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.

injuries.injury: Murray-Boyles (illness) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Celtics.
injuries.detail: The Raptors are likely to check back in with Murray-Boyles closer to Wednesday's tipoff. Jamison Battle would handle an expanded role in the frontcourt if Murray-Boyles ends up sitting out.

injuries.injury: Quickley (hamstring) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Boston.
injuries.detail: Quickley has a chance Wednesday to end a two-game absence with a hamstring injury. Jamal Shead would have the most to lose from a fantasy perspective if Quickley is able to return.

injuries.injury: Leonard (knee) is continuing the reconditioning process, and another update will be provided in one week, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
injuries.detail: With Leonard still in the rehab phase of his recovery from left knee swelling, there remains no indication of an imminent return to game action. The one-week update timeline suggests Toronto is continuing to monitor his progress before advancing to the next step, keeping his near-term availability uncertain.

injuries.injury: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.
injuries.detail: Bittle has been battling a foot injury for a couple of months. It's unknown when the rookie will be cleared to suit up for the Raptors, so he should be considered week-to-week for now.

injuries.injury: Barnes (groin) is out for Wednesday's game against Boston.
injuries.detail: The star forward is missing a third straight game with a groin strain. Ja'Kobe Walter should continue to handle additional playmaking duties in Barnes' stead.

injuries.injury: Jackson-Davis is questionable for Wednesday's game against Boston with an illness.
injuries.detail: Toronto is likely to re-evaluate Jackson-Davis at some point closer to tipoff Wednesday. Jakob Poeltl would likely handle a larger share of the center minutes if Jackson-Davis isn't feeling well enough to play.

injuries.injury: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
injuries.detail: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. That leaves Watkins in serious jeopardy of missing most, if not all, of the 2026-27 season, and it remains to be seen if the team will continue keeping him around on a two-way roster spot while he's injured.

injuries.injury: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
injuries.detail: The forward underwent surgery Wednesday to address a fractured foot, and the Wizards hope Champagnie will be ready to return at some time around the All-Star break in February. The likes of Bilal Coulibaly, Tre Johnson and Bub Carrington will all be asked to help pick up the slack for the foreseeable future.

injuries.injury: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
injuries.detail: Beekman is set for an extended absence, with his re-evaluation timeline suggesting he could remain sidelined beyond the initial three-week window. The injury further limits Washington's backcourt depth, though Beekman's absence is unlikely to have a significant impact on standard fantasy leagues.

injuries.injury: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.
injuries.detail: Vukcevic has yet to make his season debut due to a left hip impingement. The big man can be viewed as week-to-week until the Wizards provide an update on his progress.
